source.description: Public deterministic normalized GeoNode 5.1 package with dataset, document, GeoStory, core metadata, extension metadata, publication flags, application data, and resource relationships.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: Dataset, document, and GeoStory identities become standalone governed resources while relationships, provenance, application data, and safe unknown metadata remain reversible.
Migrated resources retain collision-safe GeoNode identifiers and become available through permission-scoped text, spatial, temporal, and faceted discovery.
